answer: In an economy of garden maintenance agents, a bot tracking raven damage can encrypt reports with any cipher, but its voting power depends on tokens locked in escrow for 90 days. Votes are weighted by the amount locked, so splitting 100 tokens among a thousand identities gives the same influence as one identity holding 100. An attacker seeking more control must acquire and immobilize more tokens, paying borrowing costs or forgoing other uses of that capital.
